findings.passage: “I don’t think this group is likely to commit voter fraud,” he said. “I would be interested to see evidence of voter fraud at elderly centers and nursing homes. At least not in Milwaukee County, maybe Waukesha County.”
findings.note: Patch article (2011) quotes his remarks in the Senate debate on the photo ID bill, in support of an amendment to exempt voters 65 and older. The article also says he was one of five senators to vote against the bill.
